#outlier functions
```{r}
#if the data is not normally distributed but symmetric, we recalculate the b-value
compute_b_value <- function(x) {
  # Normalize the data (z-score)
  z <- (x - mean(x, na.rm=TRUE)) / sd(x, na.rm=TRUE)
  # Get the 75th percentile
  Q75 <- quantile(z, 0.75,na.rm=TRUE)
  # Compute b value
  b_value <- 1 / Q75
  return(b_value)
}
```

```{r}
#for not normal and asymmetric data, run DoubleMad
DoubleMAD <- function(x, zero.mad.action="warn"){
   # The zero.mad.action determines the action in the event of an MAD of zero.
   # Possible values: "stop", "warn", "na" and "warn and na".
   x         <- x[!is.na(x)]
   m         <- median(x)
   abs.dev   <- abs(x - m)
   left.mad  <- median(abs.dev[x<=m])
   right.mad <- median(abs.dev[x>=m])
   if (left.mad == 0 || right.mad == 0){
      if (zero.mad.action == "stop") stop("MAD is 0")
      if (zero.mad.action %in% c("warn", "warn and na")) warning("MAD is 0")
      if (zero.mad.action %in% c(  "na", "warn and na")){
         if (left.mad  == 0) left.mad  <- NA
         if (right.mad == 0) right.mad <- NA
      }
   }
   return(c(left.mad, right.mad))
}

DoubleMADsFromMedian <- function(x, zero.mad.action="warn"){
   # The zero.mad.action determines the action in the event of an MAD of zero.
   # Possible values: "stop", "warn", "na" and "warn and na".
   two.sided.mad <- DoubleMAD(x, zero.mad.action)
   m <- median(x, na.rm=TRUE)
   x.mad <- rep(two.sided.mad[1], length(x))
   x.mad[x > m] <- two.sided.mad[2]
   mad.distance <- abs(x - m) / x.mad
   mad.distance[x==m] <- 0
   return(mad.distance)
}

#outlier=print(x[DoubleMADsFromMedian(x) > 3])


```


```{r}
#manual outlier removal
mad_outlier_manual <- function(x, b = b_val, threshold = 3, replace_na = FALSE) {

  med_x <- median(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  mad_x <- mad(x, constant = b)  # customized scale factor
  # Modified z-score
  z_mad <- (x - med_x) / (mad_x)
  
  # Identify outliers
  outlier_flag <- abs(z_mad) > threshold
  return(x[outlier_flag])
}
```

```{r}
mad_outlier_manual_asymmetric <- function(x, b = b_val, threshold = 3, replace_na = FALSE) {
  med_x <- median(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Separate values for left and right tails
  left_vals  <- x[x < med_x]
  right_vals <- x[x > med_x]
  
  # Compute MAD for each tail
  mad_left  <- if(length(left_vals)  > 0) median(abs(left_vals  - med_x)) else .Machine$double.eps
  mad_right <- if(length(right_vals) > 0) median(abs(right_vals - med_x)) else .Machine$double.eps
  
  # Modified z-scores
  z_mad <- numeric(length(x))
  z_mad[x < med_x]  <- (med_x - x[x < med_x]) / (b * mad_left)
  z_mad[x > med_x]  <- (x[x > med_x] - med_x) / (b * mad_right)
  z_mad[x == med_x] <- 0
  
  # Identify outliers
  outlier_flag <- abs(z_mad) > threshold
  
  if (replace_na) {
    x[outlier_flag] <- NA
    return(x)
  } else {
    return(x[outlier_flag])
  }
}

```

#power analysis for replication
```{r}
library(pwr)
#power analysis for sample size needed to achieve the CEA-STEU correlation based on prior study
pwr.r.test(r=0.26, sig.level = 0.05, power = 0.8, alternative = "greater")
#n=89 (total n ~ 190-200)


#power analysis for sample size needed to achieve the label/no-label distinction of sensitivity and criterion (based on CE constructed using the current full sample)
pwr.t.test(d=0.733,power=0.8,sig.level=0.05,type="two.sample",alternative="greater")
#n=24 per group

pwr.t.test(d=0.95,power=0.8,sig.level=0.05,type="two.sample",alternative="greater")
#n=14 per group

#with a third condition
library(pwr)
pwr.anova.test(k=3,f=0.733/sqrt(2),sig.level=0.05,power=0.8)

```

```{r}
lab.acc=(read.csv("Processed Data/Level1_output/lab_accuracy.csv"))[,-1]

seg.acc$condition="NoLabel"

count.acc$condition="Counting"

```

```{r}
shapiro.test(lab.acc$accuracy)#normal
a=outliers_mad(lab.acc$accuracy,b=1.4826, threshold=3, na.rm=TRUE)
a$outliers #no outlier

shapiro.test(seg.acc$accuracy)#normal
a=outliers_mad(seg.acc$accuracy,b=1.4826, threshold=3, na.rm=TRUE)
a$outliers #no outlier

shapiro.test(count.acc$accuracy)#not normal
symmetry.test(count.acc$accuracy) #symmetric
b_val=compute_b_value(count.acc$accuracy)
a=outliers_mad(count.acc$accuracy,b=b_val, threshold=3, na.rm=TRUE)
a$outliers #2 outlier


metric_name="accuracy"
df=count.acc
outlier=data.frame( 
  subjectID=df[a$outliers_pos,'Participant'],
  condition=df[a$outliers_pos,'condition'],
  metric=rep(metric_name,length(a$outliers_pos)),
  outlier_value=unname(df[a$outliers_pos,metric_name,drop=TRUE]))
outlier_log <- rbind(outlier_log, outlier)


count.acc$accuracy[count.acc$accuracy %in% a$outliers] <- NA

```

```{r}
full.acc <-rbind(lab.acc,seg.acc,count.acc)
```

##optimal deviation
```{r}
lab.optdev <- (read.csv("Processed Data/Level1_output/lab_opt_metrics_byvideo.csv"))[,-1] 
lab.optdev[sapply(lab.optdev, is.infinite)] <- NA
names(lab.optdev)[1]="subjectID"

lab.optdev <- lab.optdev  %>%
  dplyr::select(video,subjectID,c_deviation,condition) %>%
  group_by(subjectID) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(ave.c.devi=mean(na.omit(c_deviation))) %>%
  mutate(condition="WithLabel")

seg.optdev <- (read.csv("Processed Data/Level1_output/seg_opt_metrics_byvideo.csv"))[,-1] 
seg.optdev[sapply(seg.optdev, is.infinite)] <- NA
names(seg.optdev)[1]="subjectID"

seg.optdev <- seg.optdev  %>%
  dplyr::select(video,subjectID,c_deviation,condition) %>%
  group_by(subjectID) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(ave.c.devi=mean(na.omit(c_deviation))) %>%
  mutate(condition="NoLabel")

count.optdev <- (read.csv("Processed Data/Level1_output/count_opt_metrics_byvideo.csv"))[,-1] 
count.optdev[sapply(count.optdev, is.infinite)] <- NA
names(count.optdev)[1]="subjectID"

count.optdev <- count.optdev  %>%
  dplyr::select(video,subjectID,c_deviation,condition) %>%
  group_by(subjectID) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(ave.c.devi=mean(na.omit(c_deviation))) %>%
  mutate(condition="Counting")
```

```{r}
shapiro.test(lab.optdev$ave.c.devi)#normal
a=outliers_mad(lab.optdev$ave.c.devi,b=1.4826, threshold=3, na.rm=TRUE)
a$outliers #no outliers

shapiro.test(seg.optdev$ave.c.devi)#normal
a=outliers_mad(seg.optdev$ave.c.devi,b=1.4826, threshold=3, na.rm=TRUE)
a$outliers #no outliers

shapiro.test(count.optdev$ave.c.devi)#not normal
symmetry.test(count.optdev$ave.c.devi) #asymmetric
result <- count.optdev$ave.c.devi[DoubleMADsFromMedian(count.optdev$ave.c.devi) > 3] #3 from both ends

metric_name="ave.c.devi"
df=count.optdev
result_pos=which(count.optdev$ave.c.devi %in% result)
outlier=data.frame( 
  subjectID=df[result_pos,'subjectID'],
  condition=df[result_pos,'condition'],
  metric=rep(metric_name,length(result_pos)),
  outlier_value=unname(df[result_pos,metric_name,drop=TRUE]))
outlier_log <- rbind(outlier_log, outlier)


count.optdev$ave.c.devi[count.optdev$ave.c.devi %in% result] <- NA
```

```{r}
full.optdev <- rbind(lab.optdev,seg.optdev,count.optdev)

write.csv(full.optdev,"Processed Data/Level2_output/within_optdev_outremoved.csv")
```

```{r}
write.csv(outlier_log,"Processed Data/Level2_output/within_outlier_log.csv")
```
